metadata.description: FoodWeb's internal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: superpowers-foodweb
plugins.description: FoodWeb fork of obra/superpowers: skills for TDD, debugging, planning, and multi-agent orchestration. Customized for FoodWeb — worktrees pinned to .worktrees/ and opt-in only, dynamic-workflow-aware execution, generic (platform-agnostic) tooling.

plugins.name: laterm
plugins.description: Renders LaTeX math in the terminal while you use Claude Code. A PTY wrapper (`laterm claude`) rewrites $...$ / $$...$$ in the output stream into inline-image escapes (iTerm2 / Kitty protocols), plus a skill that keeps Claude's math renderable.
